method: Real app.js evaluated in Node VM with a minimal DOM, accelerated virtual timers and an idempotent mock API; deterministic logic regression, not browser/rendering/network integration QA.

checks.scenario: Hide at 80/100, complete hidden, show again without extra spins
Hide during round 81 presentation and finish 100/100
Lost response at round 81 retries same ID: 100 charges, 100 results, 101 requests
Transient 503 at round 81 recovers to exactly 100/100
Local balance check after 80 rounds shows explicit insufficient balance reason
API 409 after 80 rounds shows explicit insufficient balance reason
STOP between rounds cancels continuation with no extra charge
STOP in flight finishes current round and starts no extra rounds
Persistent connection failure stops with reason and preserves same pending ID
